subject: Re: RAG eval — model recommendations & next steps

Subject: RAG eval follow-up + recommended next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today, Jordan — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a focused eval running: 

Summary of needs
- Use case: customer support knowledge base (internal KB + product docs). Must be strong on factual grounding and keep hallucinations <2% on our test prompts.
- Expected QPS: low-to-medium initially (~10 TPS) with bursty support spikes.
- Data sensitivity: some PII in support transcripts, so we recommend VPC/private deployment for production.

Model & eval recommendations (shortlist)
1) Llama-2-70B-instruct (fp16) — good general instruction following, fast generation; may need reranker for grounding.
2) OpenSearchRAG-Redwood-v1 (quantized int4) — strong latency/cost profile; tuned for retrieval-heavy flows.
3) Claude-2.1-like (if you want conservative answers) — lower hallucination risk but higher cost.

Retrieval & grounding suggestions
- Index: chunks at ~512 tokens, metadata includes source URL, confidence bucket.
- Retriever: ANN (HNSW) for latency; set top_k=50, candidate re-rank top_n=5.
- Reranker: lightweight cross-encoder (DistilBERT cross-attention reranker) for top_n to maximize grounding precision.
- Grounding metrics: grounding precision (fraction of answers citing top-1 correct doc), hallucination rate (false factual assertions per 1000 tokens), and F1 against labeled answers in prompt set.

Attached: acme_rag_eval_plan.pdf (high-level plan + timeline), acme_prompt_sets.csv (seed prompts we propose).

Proposed immediate next steps
- I: You to confirm which model(s) you want in the shortlist (pick up to 2) — Jordan
- II: Redwood to spin up evaluation harness, populate with your sample doc set and our seed prompts (2 business days) — Marissa/Neha
- III: Joint inspection call after 72h of eval to review grounding metrics and choose reranker settings — schedule via calendar link.

If that looks good I’ll get the eval started Monday and loop in infra for VPC options.

Best,

Thanks Jordan — quick answers inline: 

1) Reranker options: Redwood provides two flavors:
   - Redwood DistilRerank (ours): distilled cross-encoder optimized for latency; good top_n precision with lower cost.
   - Full cross-encoder (BERT-large style): slightly higher precision, higher latency/cost.
   Recommendation: start with DistilRerank and we can A/B test full cross-encoder on a small sample.

2) Baseline numbers (support KBs, 50k doc index):
   - Redwood baseline (DistilRerank + OpenSearchRAG-Redwood-v1): grounding precision ~0.78, hallucination rate ~1.6% on our seed prompts.
   - Llama-2-70B-instruct w/o reranker: grounding precision ~0.62, hallucination ~3.4%.
   We’ll include these baseline dashboards in the shared Drive folder (link above).

3) Eval window: flexible — we can extend the run and keep a single result snapshot per configuration to compare. If you add prompts mid-run we recommend tagging them so we can separate continuity.

Next steps from our side: Neha will provision the index and wire your sample docs into the eval harness. Rishi will monitor costs and provide an estimated monthly TCO for the shortlisted configs once we have token distribution.
